about: The release's installers under names that never change (Session 18), so GitHub's releases/latest/download/<name> link always gives the newest one. scripts/package-release.mjs renames electron-builder's files (built) to these; scripts/release-assets.mjs puts the zips and the Windows installer in the update manifest; scripts/check-installers.mjs installs each and starts it.

files.name: Drashti-mac-apple-silicon.dmg
files.for: a Mac with Apple silicon (M1 or later)

files.name: Drashti-mac-intel.dmg
files.for: a Mac with an Intel processor

files.name: Drashti-mac-apple-silicon.zip
files.for: Drashti's own updates on an Apple-silicon Mac

files.name: Drashti-mac-intel.zip
files.for: Drashti's own updates on an Intel Mac
